# awscc_networksecuritymanager_template (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::NetworkSecurityManager::Template. Creates and manages a Network Security Manager template.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_name` (String) The name of the template.

### Optional

- `associated_rule_list` (Attributes List) List of rules associated with this template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--associated_rule_list))
- `firewall_type` (String) The type of firewall.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags associated with the template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `template_description` (String) A description of the template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the template.
- `template_arn` (String) The ARN of the template.
- `template_id` (String) The unique identifier of the template.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the template was last modified.
- `version` (String) The version number.

<a id="nestedatt--associated_rule_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `associated_rule_list`

Optional:

- `rule_arn` (String) ARN of the associated rule.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networksecuritymanager_template.example
  identity = {
    template_arn = "template_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `template_arn` (String) The ARN of the template

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networksecuritymanager_template.example
  id = "template_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_networksecuritymanager_template.example "template_arn"
```
